site_name: THE UNIVERSITY OF LOUISIANA AT MONROE

citations.narrative:
The research facility failed to submit their annual report online by the required due date in 2025. In an email response
sent to the Deputy Administrator dated 8/20/2026, and forwarded to the Veterinary Medical Officer (VMO) on 9/9/2026,
the Director of the Office of Sponsored Programs and Research wrote: "I must sincerely apologize because it appears
that the 2025 report was not properly submitted in a timely manner." An undated copy of the 2025 Annual Report was
attached to this email. At the time of the inspection a copy of the missing Annual Report was provided to the assigned
VMO. It was dated 6/6/26 for the Fiscal Year 2026 instead of the previous fiscal year of 2025.
Each reporting facility shall submit an annual report to the Deputy Administrator on or before December 1 of each
calendar year. The report shall cover the previous Federal fiscal year. The Annual Report of Research Facility (APHIS
Form 7023), Continuation Sheet for Annual Report of Research Facility (APHIS Form 7023A), and Annual Report of
Research Facility Column E Explanation (APHIS Form 7023B) are forms which may be used to submit the information
required. However, the Animal Care Public Website now states that: "All annual reports are now submitted and processed
online." See https://www.aphis.usda.gov/awa/research-facility-report to submit Annual Reports.
Correct by 9/30/2026 and forward.
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with facility representatives.
You may appeal all or part of any inspection report by submitting a written statement contesting the findings—along with
any supporting documentation—to the Deputy Administrator. Appeals of routine, focused, or attempted inspections must
be received within 21 days of report issuance as shown by the signature line of this report.
Appeals may be sent by email to AnimalCare@usda.gov.
Appeals sent by mail should be addressed to:
Deputy Administrator
APHIS Animal Care (AC)
U.S. Department of Agriculture
2150 Centre Avenue, Building B
Mailstop #3W11
Fort Collins, CO 80526-8117
